verdict.rationale: B is the lowest-priced nonstop and gives the largest conference-time buffer, but it arrives home at 2:20 a.m. Thursday. A and D cost more and/or involve a connection, yet return Maya home Wednesday night, which is a reasonable competing ordinary travel objective absent a stated preference about overnight arrival, minimizing price, or nonstop service. C is comparatively weak because it arrives only 35 minutes before the Sunday event and departs only 50 minutes after the final panel, while also costing more than B and requiring a connection.
